Mission

Give ambitious companies the design, engineering and AI of a world-class team, connected into one system that makes them look better, work smarter and grow faster.

Vision

A world where any ambitious business, wherever it starts, can launch and run like a global brand.

Built from Tamil Nadu, for the world.

01 Why we started

Good ideas deserve a connected team.

Founders and teams often juggle a designer, a developer and an automation freelancer who never talk to each other. Code Constellation was built so one team owns the whole constellation — from the first impression to the systems that run the business.

02 Where we are going

Every service is a star. Together, a shape people recognise.

Brand, product and growth connect into one system. We bring design thinking and thoughtful engineering to the same table, with a focus on clarity, craft and work that lasts.

Core values

Five values. One orbit.

  1. 01

    Craft over noise

    Every pixel and every line of code earns its place.

  2. 02

  3. 03

  4. 04

The client journey

How a client travels.

Every client enters through one pillar and grows into all three. Project, then retainer, then long-term partnership.

  1. 01 · Entry

    Brand & Create

    One niche, one clear result. The door in: a brand, a launch site, a deck or a reel.

    Project

  2. 02 · Expand

    Build

    The product, site or system the brand runs on. Same team, no hand-offs.

    Project

  3. 03 · Orbit

    Grow & Operate

    Automation, CRM, SEO and analytics on a monthly retainer. Clients stay and grow with us.

    Retainer
